## Changelog
* b57a872374b9bc6be3d4b17650cf243e5308d964 chore: update JSON schema with title and description (#1608)
* 520fd07349e0b388fa058581914163cfa761492d deps: November 2026 (#1636)
* a7ff77ed1971d34cf6d8ed8342e34eeb66d92522 deps: November 2026 (#1650)
* c8dd6e698bb930f96f705eb38bd512df4bb5ae6c deps: bump Go to 1.27.4 (#1634)
* 4fbd3851ff2496359dbb744abceb4a7bdaee2e6c feat: add LEFTHOOK_NO_AUTO_INSTALL env (#1592)
* 79bbe569fc86d3c4f70b356082a9e441805728de fix(filter): do not duplicate files matched by several glob patterns (#1630)
* d18b6834ccab191f5c3a4370074c86eb1505f41b fix: give each stdin consumer an independent reader (#1622)
* 536143cdf51d90024f574a49deb382f1665e38fe fix: stop hooks on SIGTERM and SIGHUP like on SIGINT (#1615)
* 072507445dd4795c8c35eaa583348ea05801b919 packaging: publish npm packages in different actions (#1598)
* 13d66a090ac6e73f3ff44652761facb02b00e91c pkg(pypi): tag linux wheels as musllinux compatible (#1605)
* c554647b41a87c76613ed4bda1d19b8227e72df6 refactor(config): migrate to github.com/go-viper/mapstructure/v2 (#1546)
